# WriteCode

> WriteCode (https://writecode.in) is a free online compiler and IDE that runs in the browser. People use it to write and run programs in Java, Python, C, C++, JavaScript, TypeScript, Kotlin, Go, Rust, C#, PHP, Ruby, SQL and Bash, to build web pages in HTML, CSS and JavaScript with a live preview, and to debug and visualize their code, with no installation and no sign-up.

"WriteCode" (also written "Write Code" or "writecode.in") is the name of this web application. It is not a company that writes software for clients.

## What it does

- Online compiler: real toolchains (Java 21, Python 3.13, GCC 14 for C and C++, Node.js 22 for JavaScript and TypeScript, Kotlin 2.2, Go 1.25, Rust 1.90, C# 12 on .NET 8, PHP 8.4, Ruby 3.4, SQLite for SQL, Bash 5). Programs can read typed input while they run.
- HTML, CSS and JavaScript editor: a web page with its stylesheet and script, shown in a live preview that updates as it is typed, with a console.
- Online debugger: breakpoints, stepping, variables, watches and the call stack, for Java, Python, C, C++, JavaScript, TypeScript, Kotlin, Go, Rust, PHP and Ruby.
- Code visualizer: arrays, linked lists, trees and recursion drawn step by step as the program runs.
- Test cases: inputs with expected outputs, checked in one click.
- Code together: a shared link to edit the same files live, and coding interviews with hidden tests, a timer and a report.
- Sharing: code as a PDF, Word or text file, or as a read-only link.
- Projects are saved in the user's own browser. Every program runs in an isolated sandbox with no internet access.
- Free to use.
